channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: China is shifting its new data centers to rural Eastern locations as it looks for extra AI power
item.description: China is expanding rural AI data centers for climate and land advantages, though local wage growth has lagged behind investment.

item.title: The Razer Soma Chroma has a silly name, silly price tag, and sillily requires you bring your own battery to light the thing up
item.description: The Soma Chroma is seriously comfortable. It's good at being a chair, but it's just a bit "meh" at everything else.

item.title: How is Android Auto different from Android Automotive?
item.description: While these two names sound like they'd refer to the same product, there are major differences between them.

item.title: Ukrainian drone giant Brave1 will now let military customers order custom-built drones
item.description: Brave1 launched a new marketplace letting Ukrainian military units order custom-built drones with automatic bidding, transparent pricing, and digital tracking.

item.title: Who’s behind the new ‘stealth model’ Ox Alpha?
item.description: A mysterious new AI model called Ox Alpha has driven certain corners of the internet into a frenzy of speculation.

item.title: The Garmin Venu 3 is a 'near-perfect balance of smartwatch and health tracker' — and it just dropped to its lowest price yet
item.description: In our Garmin Venu 3 review, we said it was a 'near-perfect balance of smartwatch and health tracker ', and it's currently on sale at Amazon for its lowest price yet.

item.title: How to stop Siri from interrupting while you're using CarPlay
item.description: Don't let Siri become a hassle instead of an assistant; keep it quiet in the car to reduce distractions.

item.title: Uber faces fine of nearly $1B over automated driver suspensions
item.description: The Dutch Data Protection Authority is fining Uber €825 million in the second largest penalty issued under Europe’s GDPR.
